For most people, a wild animal is a reason to keep their distance. For Ernie Brown Jr., better known as Turtleman, it's just another day on the job! From unexpected animal encounters to tricky rescue missions, he takes on creatures of all kinds with his own unmistakable style. After all, when it comes to wildlife rescue, Turtleman doesn't believe in calling any animal too wild!
Watch Call of the Wildman Season 1 Episodes 16, 18 & 19 and Season 3 Episodes 7, 8, 5 & 4 for more wild encounters, only on Animal Planet India.
